name: two_by_two_table
description: A 2×2 contingency table — test result × disease status, treatment × outcome, a payoff matrix, a confusion matrix, any two-binary-factor comparison. Choose this scene for ANY request about sensitivity/specificity, a confusion matrix (TP/FP/FN/TN), a 2×2 payoff/game matrix, or comparing two categorical variables in a grid. All geometry is computed for you; you only choose the labels, cell values, and which cell (if any) to highlight.

row_label.description: Caption for the row axis, e.g. "Test result".

col_label.description: Caption for the column axis, e.g. "Disease status".

row_values.description: The two row category names, top row first.

col_values.description: The two column category names, left column first.

cells.description: 2×2 cell values, row-major: cells[row][col]. Row 0 = top, column 0 = left.

cell_notes.description: Optional small sub-text under a cell's main value (e.g. a count under a label), same [row][col] shape as cells.

highlight.description: [row, col] pairs (0 or 1 each) to shade — e.g. [[0, 0]] to highlight the true-positive cell.

element_ids.title: figure title, when set
element_ids.hl_<r>_<c>: shaded highlight behind one cell, e.g. hl_0_0 — present only for cells named in `highlight`

examples.request: Show a 2×2 table for a diagnostic test versus disease status.
Draw a 2×2 payoff table for a simple game and highlight the outcome where both players defect.
